name: Regina
source:
Regina is a giant queen bee and the guardian of the ever-green kingdom of Viridice.
She loves and protects nature over all things and helps travelers who end up lost in her kingdom's vast and dangerous forests. Regina is usually gentle and almost motherly, but those who hurt nature can turn her switch and meet the other side of the coin.
